case_record_adapter: Use the result object of each shared-runner record with status ok.
hash_rule: SHA-256 of exact decompressed UTF-8 JSONL bytes, including newlines.
event_order: Lexical by (s,t,X,Y). IDs are local to the recorded run.
direct_outer: A cross take outside the near offer from a pure opposite endpoint holder in the first meeting round.
direct_outer_any: A cross take outside the near offer at that first meeting, including mixed lineage.
support_row_semantics: New supports in holder ID order. Concatenate through t for the post-round prefix.
